title: Let grace settle what you cannot
summary: This meets the part of life you keep trying to force into resolution. The line says grace settles what strain cannot, and peace grows where the heart stops insisting on control.
takeaway: Grace settles what strain keeps worsening.
lifeApplication: When the problem will not yield, stop tightening around it and ask what grace is already offering in the middle of it.

source.shortMeaning: Grace settles what effort alone keeps stirring up.
source.lifeApplication: When strain fails, pause and ask what grace is already offering.

evidence.coreClaim: Grace settles what effort alone keeps stirring up.
evidence.turn: Received forgiveness becomes lasting peace when it ripens into Naam.
evidence.practicalImplication: When the problem will not yield, stop tightening around it and ask what grace is already offering in the middle of it.
